newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 1995 GDP rose only 0.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 1995 GDP rose only 0.1 percent.

text.p: Swiss Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rose at an annual rate of 0.1 percent in the 1995, the Federal Statistics office said, revising down earlier government estimates that GDP grew by 0.7 percent.
The earlier estimate of 0.7 percent growth was prepared by the Federal Office for Economic Issues and was based on projections drawn from quarterly data.
The Federal Statistics Office said the economy stagnated last year as the stimulating effect of domestic demand was neutralised by a worsening balance in trade and services.
In all, GDP grew a real 0.1 percent to 209.3 billion francs.
